title: Concept: Tornado HTTP error with its traceback
description: A Tornado HTTPError whose traceback is rendered in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The traceback names the handler class and the file, and Tornado prints the request arguments alongside it when debug mode is on.
applicability: Deployments that render a Tornado HTTPError whose traceback is rendered into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The traceback names the handler class and the file, and Tornado prints the request arguments alongside it when debug mode is on.
